tasks.notes: Commit ff556c785. Declared `.default(false)` WITHOUT `.optional()`, deviating from the three sibling flags (profileCompleted/setPasswordPrompted/serviceSuspended): the column is NOT NULL DEFAULT false, and `.optional()` would only widen the output type to `boolean | undefined` for a case the DB cannot produce, forcing `?? false` on every predicate consumer. SCOPE ADDITION the task did not list: `isSystemAccount` must also be OMITTED from UserUpdateInputSchema. Zod 4's `.partial()` keeps `.default()` and BaseCrudService.update re-parses through that schema (SPEC-217 precedent, documented in the file's own JSDoc), so leaving it settable means any unrelated profile save re-injects `false` and clears the flag — turning a staff account back into an indexable author page, i.e. the AC-16/R-9 bug arriving through a different door.
